SELECT FN_MAKE_CODE('PAY') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_CODE, SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TOTAL_PRICE, PAYMENT_STAT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_DATE, CARD_COMPANY, BILLING_START, BILLING_END, PAYMENT_KEY, ORDER_ID, BILLING_KEY, PAYMENT_TYPE, CARD_NUMBER_MASK, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{paymentCode}, #{subCode}, #{companyCode}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentStat}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentDate}, #{cardCompany}, #{billingStart}, #{billingEnd}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{billingKey}, #{paymentType}, #{cardNumberMask}, #{discountAmount}, #{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.COMPANY_CODE, s.CURRENT_PRICE, s.CURRENT_USER_COUNT, s.PLAN_CODE, s.SUBS_START, s.SUBS_END, s.SUB_CODE, s.SUBS_STATUS, s.BILLING_PERIOD, s.NEXT_BILLING_DATE, s.RECENT_BILLING_DATE FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE s JOIN TB_COMPANY_MASTER c ON s.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE WHERE SUBS_STATUS = 'EXPIRED' ORDER BY RECENT_BILLING_DATE

SELECT s.SUB_CODE, s.COMPANY_CODE, s.SUBS_STATUS, s.SUBS_START, s.SUBS_END, s.CREATED_BY, s.CREATE_DATE, s.UPDATED_BY, s.UPDATE_DATE, s.PLAN_CODE, p.PRICE, t.PAYMENT_METHOD, t.PAYMENT_STAT, s.CONTRACT_CODE, s.BILLING_PERIOD, s.CURRENT_USER_COUNT, s.CURRENT_PRICE, s.NEXT_BILLING_DATE, s.RECENT_BILLING_DATE FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBS_START DESC) AS rn FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE s WHERE s.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ) WHERE rn = 1 ) s JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE_PLAN p ON p.PLAN_CODE = s.PLAN_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.CREATE_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM TB_PAYMENT t WHERE t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ) WHERE rn = 1 ) t ON t.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE

SELECT PAYMENT_CODE, SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ORDER_ID, TOTAL_PRICE, PAYMENT_STAT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_DATE, CARD_COMPANY, PAYMENT_KEY, BILLING_START, BILLING_END, PAYMENT_TYPE, CARD_NUMBER_MASK, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE FROM TB_PAYMENT WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ORDER BY PAYMENT_DATE DESC
